Chapter 1059: 11 Conditions Of The Eye Of Myriad Laws (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2

Chapter 1059: Chapter 11 Conditions of the Eye of Myriad Laws (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2

The stronger the power, the higher the realm, and the more it inspires reverence.

Lin Yuan felt waves surging in his heart upon hearing this.

An evolutionary path that opens branch routes?

The Eye of Myriad Laws knows that the Life and Death Martial Dao is a branch route pioneered from the Martial Arts Evolution Road?

Lin Yuan’s thoughts fluctuated as he quickly came to terms with it. According to Xuanhuang’s speculation, the Eye of Myriad Laws is related to the Thirteenth Layer of temporal beings and possesses the ability to see through all Myriad Laws and Paths. It’s not surprising that it knows the true essence of the Life and Death Martial Dao.

“Do you wish to use my Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion to propagate your evolutionary path?”

The Eye of Myriad Laws spoke directly.

“Yes.”

Lin Yuan nodded and admitted.

In the eyes of an ancient entity like the Eye of Myriad Laws, there was no need to conceal anything.

“Throughout countless Cosmic Eras, countless Chaos Cycles, there have indeed been many lives like you who wished to leverage my Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion to spread their evolutionary paths. Many of them have now cultivated to the peak of the Chaos Realm.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws spoke.

“Peak of the Chaos Realm?”

Lin Yuan was deeply shocked.

The peak of the Chaos Realm signifies the status of a Chaos Great Saint. As for a Peerless Great Saint? Essentially, they too have reached the peak of the Chaos Realm, except their combat prowess far surpasses that of a Chaos Great Saint.

So far, Lin Yuan had encountered only two individuals at the peak of the Chaos Realm: the Master of the Magic Jade Tower and Xuanhuang.

These two were not merely at the pinnacle of the Chaos Realm but were Peerless Great Saints who transcended even Chaos Great Saints.

Even entities as mighty as Chaos Venerables could only flee desperately in front of the peak Chaos Realm beings.

Additionally, the Shadow Demon Great Saint and the Nine Phoenix Great Saint were also at the peak of the Chaos Realm.

However, Lin Yuan had not personally interacted with these two Great Saints, merely suffering the aftermath of their violent clashes.

“Of course, some are trapped in time loops, neither truly alive nor dead, tormented for eternity.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws continued.

“Trapped in time loops?”

Lin Yuan’s tone carried a trace of confusion.

“To step from the Twelfth Layer to the Thirteenth Layer, one must break free from their own time loop.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws replied nonchalantly.

“Break free from the time loop?”

Lin Yuan’s expression grew heavy.

This was the first time he had ever heard such information about breaking through from the Twelfth Layer to the Thirteenth Layer.

Time loop?

Breaking free?

To ascend to the Thirteenth Layer requires breaking free from the time loop?

“What if one fails to break free?”

Lin Yuan couldn’t help but ask.

“If you fail, then you fail. You will remain forever trapped in the time loop.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws responded.

“In truth, being trapped in a time loop isn’t painful. Within the loop, everything follows a predetermined trajectory—no surprises, no possibilities, just endless repetition.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws said with a tinge of lamentation.

“It truly doesn’t sound painful.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Yet to those at the peak of the Chaos Realm, such a state was worse than death.

The peak of the Chaos Realm signified entities that looked down upon all existence, be it the Chaos Void or the Origin World that Lin Yuan had descended into. Beings like the Chaos Great Saints and Great Saint Venerables stood at the pinnacle of supremacy.

“You only need to know a little; there’s no need to delve into details. Every Chaos Realm peak existence faces a unique time loop when attempting to step into the Thirteenth Layer. Knowing in advance won’t provide any benefit.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws advised.

“I see.”

Lin Yuan had a moment of realization.

No wonder neither the Profound Xuanhuang lineage nor the Magic Jade Tower had left behind any intelligence or records about breaking through from the Twelfth to the Thirteenth Layer.

Because unless one reached the completion of the Twelfth Layer, knowing this information in advance was meaningless. Once at Twelfth Layer completion, even without seeking it out, one would naturally come to know these truths.

“So the sudden disappearance of Xuanhuang and the Master of the Magic Jade Tower—could it be they were trapped in time loops?” Lin Yuan speculated in his mind.

As of now, no Twelfth Layer existence had emerged from the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path, yet Xuanhuang had suddenly vanished, a situation very akin to being caught in a time loop.

Based on the description provided by the Mirror of Myriad Laws, being trapped in a time loop was a state of neither life nor death—not true demise, nor genuine vitality.

“Does propagating one’s evolutionary path help in breaking free from the time loop?” Lin Yuan inquired.

“You’ve come all this way—do you even need to ask?”

The Eye of Myriad Laws cast another scrutinizing glance at Lin Yuan and explained, “In a time loop, relying solely on oneself to break free leaves the chances too slim to count on. However, leveraging external ‘anchors’ or ‘beacons’ can enhance the probability of escape.”

“Thus, many Chaos Realm beings prepare in advance, intending to utilize the influence of my Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion to propagate their evolutionary paths, thereby increasing their odds of breaking through to the Thirteenth Layer.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws paused and looked at Lin Yuan with a hint of peculiarity. “But for someone like you, at just the Path Splitting Realm, seeking to propagate your evolutionary path—well, that’s extremely rare.”

This was also why the Eye of Myriad Laws had been willing to chat with Lin Yuan thus far.

Path Splitting Realm beings have no understanding of their road’s end, nor can they determine whether they might switch to a different evolutionary path in the future. Almost no one at that stage would attempt to propagate their evolutionary path.

Even those with unparalleled backing—elders who had reached the peak of the Chaos Realm—would not act so recklessly.

Otherwise, if midway through the propagation they realized the path didn’t suit them and ended up “dispelling their path” to choose another evolutionary road, all their previous efforts would be for naught.

For Lin Yuan to dare to attempt such a thing, there could be only one explanation.

He was utterly certain that this evolutionary path was suitable for him, a certainty that only arose when the evolutionary path was one he had personally pioneered and perfected.

Only a route he had opened and refined himself would align with him so completely. As for following someone else’s pioneering evolutionary path?

Only those who had cultivated to the Chaos Realm could be confident about whether or not that path suited them. For Path Splitting Realm and Sovereign Realm beings, the uncertainty was simply too great.
